subject: Finally Gave Paradise A Bit Of Time
author: ichienkai
body:
Yup as the title says.....  What am i to make of it?  Truth is i dont want to make anything of it!  Like you Bootle Mc Poodle all i wanna do is race: No Crash, No Raging and definately None of that showtime stuff.  Ive said it somewhere else and i'll stick with it... Im reserving judgement on Burnout Paradise which means i dont agree or disagree with what you yourself  Bootyglitchus Maximus or anybody else has said about it.  All i want from a Burnout game is a laugh - to face massive oncoming, to scrap with buddies and go damn fast.  Paradise will have these four desired elements in the game so i'll no doubt be happy but i'm still Revenge hardcore i guess.

As for Mr Glitchy, yes you finally cheated to win a Mountain race!  Will i ever become king of the mountain if you are racing like a demon on there? Doubt it.

And the ranked thing well yeah i want to give the numbers away on the other tags so i can cancel them completely and just have this one.  My philosophy on tags is changing so if you see a Serpo, Grrrrrr Baby or "im killing time" room open then jump in by all means, you can have some low rank very easily probably - you wont see them in the near future anyway.

--So Many Strings To Your Bow: Why Not Let One Go?-- http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wmnb26tZOGw&feature=related
